correctness.rationale: For nonzero frequency difference (a,b), factor p^j where j is its minimum truncated p-adic valuation: K_k(a,b)=p^j K_{k-j}(a',b'). At m=1 a cyclotomic coefficient polynomial has p-1 total counts and cannot vanish at the primitive pth root; for m>=2 primitive stationary-phase cancellation gives zeros exactly when a'b' is zero or a nonsquare mod p, while the two lifted stationary phases and nonzero quadratic Gauss sum prove nonvanishing for nonzero squares. Orthogonality is exactly the first unequal base-p digit compatibility relation at a depth <=k-2. Distinct siblings have distinct v-u, hence <=p children; terminal level permits <=1. Construction {(j,0):0<=j<p^(k-1)} attains p^(k-1), strictly less than phi(p^k), even when k=1. Independent exact cyclotomic checks for p,k=(3,1),(3,2),(3,3),(5,2) matched the predicted zeros on all 1440 frequency pairs; these finite checks only corroborate the proof. Inspected bundled verify_hyperbola.py and all actual source package files, never treated VERIFY_OK as universal proof.
